items.title: Post food by voice with AI-extracted description, portions and pickup time
items.detail: The PRD asks donors to speak or type a food description and have portions and pickup time extracted, with manual posting as the fallback. Voice capture and the AI extraction layer are a whole part of the app.
items.why: Voice capture and AI extraction with fallbacks is a large, integration-heavy part, and donors can already post manually.
items.note: Saved for after the first build.

items.title: Stop listing donations once their pickup-by time has passed
items.detail: The PRD asks for server-side enforcement of deadline rules and a pickup-by time on each donation. The plan never expires or closes a donation at that time, so NGOs could still claim food that can no longer be collected.

items.title: Show the 0.35 kg per portion assumption in settings and on the sponsor dashboard
items.detail: The PRD asks for a configurable impact assumption of 0.35 kg per portion, disclosed in the interface. The Settings screen only covers illustrative cost, so the kg-per-portion value is not configurable or labelled as an assumption.
